title: Textbook Reading: Save Our Planet
description: Based on a middle-school English textbook passage. Expert groups deduce key vocabulary from clues and earn word cards. Home groups complete a shared summary worksheet — you cannot place your own word in your own blank.

clues.stage1: It means all the natural world around us.
clues.stage2: We must protect our ___ to live safely.
clues.stage3: The first sentence of the passage says 'our environment'.
clues.stage4: An 11-letter English word starting with e.

clues.stage1: It makes air, water, or land dirty.
clues.stage4: A 10-letter English word starting with p.

clues.stage1: Using paper or plastic again instead of throwing it away.
clues.stage3: It appears in the last sentence of the passage.
